trust_decision.summary: Untrusted Turtle/N3 text and caller-supplied base IRIs/format strings must be matched by regexes in linear time; decided in the lexer token regexes (N3Lexer), base IRI handling (N3Parser constructor, _resolveRelativeIRI, BaseIRI). At the pinned commit every regex change of the advisory commit b1c497f is ALREADY present; only 5b28333 (prefix/quantifier lookup through Object.create scope chains, O(depth) per lookup) is missing.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names the N3Lexer numeric-literal regex; _number is applied to every token starting with a digit/sign at src/N3Lexer.js:335-336. It is already the fixed (linear) form at the pinned commit.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The writer-side BaseIRI.js:9 would have qualified as lower_level_api, but it is already fixed at the pin.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only the remaining scope-chain issue is open. A solver could call it a performance or correctness refactor (prototype-chain lookup depth), not the 'numeric-literal regex' named in the advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Prefix and @base declarations must stay scoped to their formula and be restored on exit. Blank-node label prefix '_' is set per scope. Quantified variables must be visible in nested scopes.

O6_input_shapes: number tokens: integer, decimal, double with exponent, leading sign, leading dot (already fixed)
base IRI with or without query
nested N3 formulas / blank node lists / lists (scope chain, unfixed)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Writer literal-shortcut regexes for integer/decimal/double could be written with the same ambiguous \d*(\.)?\d+ idiom the lexer used to have.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same numeric grammar as the lexer, in a different file (writer). A maintainer could plausibly copy the old lexer pattern there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: escapedLiteral /^"(.*".*)(?="[^"]*$)/ runs on literal term ids during termToId/termFromId.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Data-factory serialization path, far from the lexer. Its backtracking cost on quote-heavy literals has not been verified.

O9_family: ReDoS / algorithmic complexity (CWE-1333); remaining unfixed part is super-linear prefix/quantifier lookup via deep prototype chains

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite the _number regex (already linear at the pin), or cap formula nesting depth instead of removing the scope chain.

out_of_scope_notes: src/N3DataFactory.js:14 escapedLiteral regex is a possible separate regex-cost candidate. Not pursued.
